sentences.en: You may as well withdraw from the club right away.
sentences.zh: 你最好马上退出这个俱乐部。

sentences.en: Three quarters of the members of this club are girls.
sentences.zh: 这个俱乐部里有四分之三的成员是女生。

sentences.en: I went camping in the Japan Alps with my club.
sentences.zh: 我和我的俱乐部一起去日本阿尔卑斯山露营了。

senses.zh: 俱乐部，社团；夜总会；棍棒；（扑克牌中的）梅花
